legacy.claim: The model as stated (static or accumulating depletion, no clock mechanism) is consistent with measured gravitational time dilation
legacy.evidence: **Derived (ORB-10159, § clock sector below):** a static scarcity field with universal tick rate predicts exactly zero dilation against the measured ladder — Pound–Rebka/Snider at 1%, Gravity Probe A tracking the GM/r *profile* to 7×10⁻⁵, GPS +38.6 μs/day as engineering fact, optical clocks resolving 1 mm ([studies/gravitational-time-dilation](../../studies/gravitational-time-dilation.md)). The accumulating variant (consumption, no replenishment) is separately dead: σ̇/σ ~ 1/t_age ≈ 2×10⁻¹⁰ yr⁻¹ is an effective Ġ/G more than three orders above the LLR bound (7.1 ± 7.6)×10⁻¹⁴ yr⁻¹. Only the steady-state flow (river) branch survives as a dynamical completion — next row (where ORB-10162 has since measured the mechanic's natural rules failing to produce it)
